headline: Sunraycer Acquires 325 MWac Solar Portfolio in Illinois and Missouri
summary: Sunraycer Renewables acquired a 325 MWac solar portfolio in Illinois and Missouri from Apricus Energy, expanding its development pipeline in the MISO footprint.
why: Independent power producers expand renewable energy portfolios through asset acquisitions to scale generation capacity in regional electricity markets.

impacts.name: Sunraycer Renewables
impacts.why: Sunraycer acquired a solar portfolio to expand its development footprint.
